estimates_and_reserves.finding: Warranty is the only reserve the record tags. The accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual.value} a year earlier; the ratio to quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value}, fourth highest of eight quarters, slightly below the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value} and above the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value}; and the numbers reader shows releases of prior estimates shrinking to nil for nine months. The reserve is not thinning and is not being released into income. The bad-debt allowance and inventory reserve are untagged in every period, so those ratios cannot be tested; the note calls credit-loss reserves not material. Goodwill shows no impairment indicator and an unchanged carrying amount. The effective tax rate is the estimate that moves income: the trailing rate is {tax_rate.value|pct} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.value}, and the note names the tax-free Sandisk gain, excess windfall tax benefits recognized in income tax expense, the FDDEI deduction and credits as drivers. The windfall benefit is discrete and share-price dependent, the tax-free gain ends once the remaining shares are exchanged, and the comparative quarter carried a one-time deferred tax benefit from a Separation-related asset transfer, so year-over-year tax comparisons are distorted in both directions. Unrecognized tax benefits rose, which builds rather than releases reserve. The new derivative for the tendered convertible notes' conversion feature is a fair-value estimate with an immaterial gain. No estimate change raised income; the windfall benefit lowers tax but its amount is not in the calculator, so no adjustment is listed.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Reserves are stable or building; the low effective tax rate is driven by a tax-free non-operating gain and discrete windfall benefits that will not persist.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Disclosure controls are reported effective with no change in internal control; there is no auditor's report in a 10-Q bundle, and the 8-K index shows no auditor-change or non-reliance item. No chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller departure appears; the only personnel items are selling plans adopted by the chief executive, a director and the chief legal officer. The numbers reader compared superseded prior-quarter rows and found no restated value; the convertible conversion price moved slightly without a restatement marker, which the notes reader shows as a routine adjustment to the stated term. Tag discipline is the weak spot: depreciation is tagged under a different concept from the prior 10-Q, dividends paid under a different concept from the prior year, receivables are printed at two precisions under one paragraph, and a liquidation preference is still tagged for preferred stock whose carrying amount is zero after the mandatory conversion. The debt note and MD&A give different figures for the exchange cost; the tagged components in the numbers report show the MD&A figure is the total loss on extinguishment and the note's figure is the term-loan component alone, with the senior-note issuance-cost write-off the remainder. The 8-K file contradicts itself on whether a results 8-K exists and carries no body, so the earnings release cannot be matched to the 10-Q. A late-filing notice exists for the period ended in late 2023, two years before this filing. Related-party exposure is the transition services agreement with Sandisk, called not material; no subsidiary-list diff or comment letter is in the input.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No control or audit red flag; several XBRL tagging inconsistencies and an unverifiable earnings release are the only signals.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Of the notes items carrying an expected direction, the numbers confirm the debt retirement, the exchange charge, the preferred conversion, the revenue, margin and receivables explanations, the restructuring continuation and the tax-rate drivers. They contradict the inventory item: MD&A describes a reduction in inventory, but the balance rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} year over year and the year-to-date cash-flow line is an increase of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date.value}, so the prose refers to a smaller cash build than the prior year's {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}, not to a lower balance. They leave unresolved the forward-looking items (lower interest, end of participating-securities allocation, buybacks, the remaining Sandisk exchange, derivative remeasurement, hedge reclassification), the end-market and geographic revenue claims for which the record carries no rows, and the operating cash-flow timing items that have no calculator field. The note-versus-MD&A exchange-cost difference is explained by tagged components. The 8-K earnings release is not in the bundle, so it cannot be matched to the 10-Q.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Prose and numbers agree on every material item, with one literal contradiction on inventory that is a wording matter, and the earnings release unverifiable.

summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 보고되었고 감사인 변경이나 재무책임자 교체는 없다. 다만 감가상각 태그 변경, 전환 후에도 남은 우선주 청산가치 태그, 주석과 경영진 설명의 교환비용 수치 차이 같은 표기 불일치가 있고, 실적 발표 8-K 본문이 없어 10-Q와 대조할 수 없다.

summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮고 구매약정은 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value}로 줄어 재고 진부화나 과잉 약정 신호가 없다. 상위 열 개 고객이 매출의 {concentration.facts.27.value|pct}를 차지하고 최대 고객의 매출채권 비중이 {concentration.facts.35.value|pct}까지 올라간 집중도가 유일한 관찰 대상이다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
